title: Compare regex sugar and primitives
description: This program compares sugary token patterns with versions written using alternation, concatenation, and star.

steps.description: TOKENS pairs each familiar token pattern with a version expressed in bare primitives. The identifier and float primitive patterns use shorter character menus to keep the examples readable.
INPUTS supplies matching and nonmatching strings for each token kind.
For each input, the program uses fullmatch on both patterns and marks a disagreement when their Boolean results differ.

steps.question: What summary appears when both patterns agree on every listed input?
steps.answer: The summary says 'identical on every input' because disagreements stays at zero.

steps.description: Each token prints its comparison summary. The final lines state the intended lesson that sugar improves readability without adding power.
After the integer inputs, the program prints that its two patterns agreed on every listed input.
